translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Juan

content: Tsemets a Lázaro
C’uajat jun i ya’ul ti bichou Betania im bij Lázaro. Pel in ebchal a María ani a Marta.
Pel jaja’ a María ax ti jayq’ui’ in jolchi i nihuihuiltalab tin acan a Jesús ani in huayethanchi c’al in xi’il. Pel in ebchal Lázaro axi ya’ul.
Abchinal an cau a Jesús c’al a María ani a Marta ca uchan an cau antse’: ―Ajatic, ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta abal te a ja’ub Lázaro u ya’ul.

Tam ti olchinits antsana’ an cau a Jesús, in ulu: ―Aba ani’ ya’ul yab ne’ets ca t’ayat tsemets. C’al jahua’ cu t’ajchi a Lázaro ne’ets tu tejhua’methanchi in tsap a Dios ani nana’ u tsap tin Tsacamil a Dios.
A Jesús in lej ichich hual tsu’tal a Marta ani a María ani a Lázaro.
Aba ani’ olchinenequits abal ya’ul a Lázaro, bel jilc’one taja’ tsab a q’uicha jun ti c’uajat.
Taley talbel a Jesús tu ucha’ huahua’ tu exobalilchic: ―Huana cu c’ale junil ti Judea.
I toc’tsiy: ―¿Exobchix, jale’ ta le’ quit huichiy tihua’ junil, ani tats tit le’name quit tsemtha c’al i t’ujub c’al talchic i Israelchic?

A Jesús tu ucha’chic: ―Biyat yabaye u talchamal in t’ojlabil a Dios ax tin abamal, yabaye ne’ets quin tsemtha. Hua’ats jat’hua’ lajuj tsab i hora tam tajaxe ta q’uicha ca xe’tsin an inic yab ca t’ithc’uan.
Expith tam acal tam ti yic’uaxits hualam ne’ets ca t’ithc’uan, cum yab hua’ats i tajax.
Talbel a Jesús tu uchaye: ―U huayitsits i ja’ub Lázaro. Ne’ets quin c’ale cu ejtsintha’.
Tam huahua’ i uchal a Jesús: ―Ajatic, alhua’ abal max huayitsits, cum ne’ets hualam elabmelits an yau’lats.
Tam tin ulu a Jesús abal huayitsits a Lázaro, in le’ quin ulu abal tsemetsits. Huahua’ i tsalpanchalq’ui abal coyomathq’ui ti huayal.
Tam a Jesús tu lejquith ucha’chic: ―Tsemetsits a Lázaro.
Alhua’ abal in jilc’onenec teje’ ani yabaye in c’alnec c’al a Lázaro, cum talbel tata’chic más ne’ets tiquin lej bela’. Huanats qui tsu’u xohue’.
Tam cau a Tomás axi uxnal ti cuaya’cua’. Tu ucha’ huahua’ tu at exobalchic: ―Cu c’alehue c’al a Jesús ani cu junax tsemtha c’al jaja’.
A Jesús pel i ejthax c’al an tsemelom ani pel i pithoblix c’al i it ejattalab
Ulits a Jesús jun ti jolith a Lázaro, olchin abal tse’its a q’uicha ti joliyame.
Am bichou Betania c’uajat utat ti bichou Jerusalén jelat max tsab c’al ts’ejel i kilómetro.
Tats ti ultsits yan i Israelchic quin ts’abiy a Marta ani a María quin culbethanchi in ichich, cum in tso’obits abal tsemetsits in ebchal Lázaro.
Cum olchinal a Marta abal ta tal a Jesús, c’ale abal quin tamu. A Maria jats jilc’on tin q’uima’.
Ulits a Marta, in ucha’ a Jesús: ―Ajatic, max it c’uajatac yabac tsemenec u ebchal Lázaro.
Aba ani’ tsemenequits, u tso’obits abal ne’ets ca ejtha c’al a Dios.
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Ne’ets ca ejtha ani ca xe’tsine ejat junil a ebchal.
Uchan a Jesús tam: ―U tso’obits abal ne’ets ca ejtha tam quim baju an taltalab q’uicha tam a Dios ne’ets quin tala’ ejtha’ an tsemelomchic.
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Nana’its in ejthax c’al an tsemelomchic ani im pithoblix c’al i it ejattalab. Aba ani’ max ca tsemets jitats tiquim bela’ nana’, bel ne’ets cu ejtha’ junil talbel.
Ne’ets ca c’uajiy it ejatlith abal ets’ey yab quin leca’ an lej tsemla jitats belom c’al nana’. ¿A belal axe’ xi cau?
Tam toc’tsin a Marta: ―U lej belal Ajatic abal pel ti Tsacamil a Dios. Pel it Cristo ax it bijithits ne’ets quit aban c’al a Dios quit chich.
Uc’nal a Jesús tin jolimtal a Lázaro
Talits ti t’ilom a Marta c’al a Jesús, huichits c’al a María quin caniy ca chich c’al a Jesús quin tsu’u. In cue’ ucha’: ―An Exobchix Jesús tax talits utat in le’ abal quit c’ale ca tsu’u.
Tam ti olchinits an cau a María, tam ta c’ale thubat quin tsu’u a Jesús.
Yabaye ulnec a Jesús ti bichou Betania, c’uajate tihua’ jun ti tamuhuat c’al a Marta.

An Israelchic axi c’uajat abal quin culbethanchi in ichich a María in tsu’u abal thubat c’alets. Ani c’alechic jaja’ jaye, cum in tsalpayal abal a María ne’ets quin tsa’biy an jolimtalab ani ca uq’uin taja’.
Ultsits a María taja’ jun ti c’uajat a Jesús, in tuthu in c’ualal tin tamet ani in ucha’: ―Ajatic, max it c’uajatac yabac tsemenec u ebchal Lázaro.
Tam tin tsu’u a Jesús uc’nal a María ani an Israelchic axi c’uajat taja’, in ats’a’ tim ba’ lej t’elelel in ichich ani lej ej’el.
Tam in conoychic: ―¿Ju’ta ta joliyamal a Lázaro? Uchan a Jesús: ―Quit utey Ajatic abal ca tsu’u.
Tam uc’nal a Jesús jaye.
Tam in ulu an Israelchic axi taja’chic: ―Ca t’aja’ ti cuenta abal lej ichich hual tsu’tom c’al a Lázaro.
Talchic jaja’chic in ulu: ―Ja’its axe’ xi inic ax in tsu’uxmetha’ an joc’tsi, ani hualam max pelac in culbetal in ejtohuamalac quin jeltha’ a Lázaro ani yab ca tsemets.
Ejtha a Lázaro
Junil in ats’a’ a Jesús lej ej’el tin ichich. Tam utey jun ti jolith a Lázaro al i jol paxal t’ujub axi paxq’uithits c’al i pulic t’ujub.
A Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Ca tixc’a’chic an t’ujub taja’. Uchan c’al a Marta in uxum ebchal an tsemelom: ―Ajatic, cum tse’its a q’uicha ti tsemenec hualam pet’el caxiyits.
Uchan a Marta c’al a Jesús: ―Ca t’ila’ jahua’ nan tu ucha’its, max a belal nan ne’ets tu tejhua’methanchi in tsap a Dios.
Tam in tixc’a’chic an t’ujub. Tam a Jesús in met’a’ hualq’ui’ ti eb ani in ulu: ―U binal i c’ac’namal yan Tata ti eb, cum tin ats’anchamal u conchixtal.
Aba ani’ u tso’obits abal ets’ey tin ats’anchal jahuaquitsq’ui tu conchi, bel tu mo’canchal u conchixtal abal antsana’ axi teje’ muthatchic quin lej bela’ abal tata’ tin aba’ quin chich teje’ tsabal.
Tam tin uluhuits antsana’, tam lej thajan a Jesús: ―Lázaro, quit cale tana’.
Ani cale a Lázaro malithe c’al i malilil toltom ani c’al jun i toltom thu’bathe tin oc’. A Jesús in ucha’chic axi taja’ c’uajat: ―Ca huilchi an malilil toltom abal ca hualcanits.
An tomolnaxchic in le’ac quin yac’ua’ a Jesús
C’al axe’ xi pulic tsu’bixtalab in t’aja’ a Jesús, jats ti belan c’al yan i Israelchic axi che’nequits c’al a María jun ti joliyame a Lázaro. In tsu’uchic ani im bela’chic.
Ani talchic jaja’chic c’ale quin olchi an fariseochic jahua’ a Jesús in t’ajchamal a Lázaro.

Tam nixe’ an fariseochic ani c’al axi pel i ts’alechic pale’ c’ale quin tauna’ an cuenel axi c’athpich exbath ti ts’ejcom c’al an cau tin cuenta an tiyopan. In ucha’chic: ―¿Jant’o ne’ets qui t’aja’, cum axe’ xi inic xe’ets in t’ajal yan i labith t’ajbilab?
Lejat patal an inicchic ne’ets ca belomats max qui jila’ antsana’ ca xe’tsine. Hualam max ca chich an romanochic tucu tsemtha’ ani tucu t’ajat talabethanchi i tiyopanil.
Tam jun axi taja’ c’al jaja’chic im bij a Caifás ani pel i ts’ale pale’ nixe’ xi tamub, in ucha’chic: ―Tata’chic ojni’ yab it tsalpath.
Ca t’aja’ ti cuenta abal alhua’ ca tsemtha juncats i inic, ani yab cu talabetha huahua’ tu bichou.

Caifás yab in elentha’ nixe’ xi cau tin cuete’ oc’. Antsana’ ti cahuintha c’al a Dios, abal a Jesús ne’ets ca tsemtha ti calchix c’al am bichou Israel. Cum pel i ts’ale pale’ a Caifás nixe’ xi tamub, antsana’ in ucha’ in at juntalchic.
Ani yab expith ca tsemtha a Jesús abal ca jec’ontha am bichou Israel, jaye abal ca jec’ontha ani ca mulcuhuat patal in tsacamilchic a Dios axi buc’uc’ul xe’ets tim puhuel an tsabal.
Ma tam nixe’ xa q’uichajits an oc’lecchic c’al an Israel in luba’ quin ts’ejca’ an cau jant’ini’ ti quin tsemtha’ a Jesús.

Jaxtam a Jesús yabats lej tejhua’ xe’ets jun ti ca tsu’tat c’al an Israelchic. Cale ti Judea ani c’ale ti jun i bichou im bij Efraín axi utat i joltam. Tats ti jilc’on a Jesús ani jaye huahua’ tu exobalil.

Cum yabats más ohuat a q’uicha ne’ets quim baju an Israelchic quin t’aja’ an ajib tin cuenta abal ti calthame ti Egipto im biyal juntalchic, tamcunenequits yan i inicchic ti Jerusalén quin oc’ox t’oquetha’ tim ba’ jant’ini’ ti uchbith c’al an ts’ejcath cau axi jilchin c’al a Moisés.
Talchic jaja’chic xe’ets alilil max quin ela’ a Jesús. Talchic axi al an tiyopan xe’ets in conoyalchic: ―¿Jant’o a tsalpayal hualam ne’ets ca chich a Jesús c’al an ajib?
An fariseochic ani an ts’ale pale’chic in abchamalits’ an cau am bichou abal ca tso’oblinchat max ca tsu’tat ju’ta a Jesús, cum ne’ets ca abchin jita’ ta ca yac’uan.
